purpose: First-party facts from the maker's own documents, compared against data/specs/bernina-570-qe.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: Bernina US page for the 2017 and later model; lists $5,499 MSRP and a features table shared in layout with the 540 and 590 pages
Lists the English manual, firmware V39.03.15 (2025-07-10) and the Type VIO versus Type LUN label note
Technical data p.164, supplied accessories p.19 to 22. The support page also links an 'EN Updated' 2023-08 file (30A_04) which downloaded byte-identical in size

documents.type: US warranty page (search excerpt, not a full scrape)
documents.note: Warranty is generic to Bernina US, not model-specific
Says 'This product is no longer available'; 7.5 in, 5.5 mm, 900 spm, 642 stitches, 33 lb, BSR included
1,048 stitches; 14 buttonholes; 43 quilting stitches; no price; page says 'no longer available'

facts.value: $5,499.00 labelled 'Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price' on the US product page; dealers set their own price
facts.note: Page also carries a Buy Now link to shop.berninausa.com and a Find a store link. Stitch Check shows no buy button for Bernina (dealer-only rule).

site.label: List price
site.juki: $5,499 manufacturer suggested retail price, with a Find a store link.
site.others: Dealers set their own price; we show a band, not a live price.

facts.value: 1450 sewing stitch patterns including alphabets; 450 decorative, 25 practical, 73 quilting, 8 alphabets
facts.note: The 642 figure some dealers quote is Bernina's own figure for the before 2017 570 QE (maker-pre2017). The 240 figure on one dealer page has no Bernina source.

site.label: Stitches
site.juki: 1,450 including alphabets (450 decorative, 25 practical, 73 quilting, 8 alphabets).
site.others: Matches our spec. Dealers quoting 642 are describing the older machine.

facts.value: 16 buttonholes and eyelets; automatic length-measuring one-step buttonhole and manual multi-step
1000 stitches per minute (page and manual technical data)

site.label: Max speed
site.juki: 1,000 spm on the product page and in the manual technical data.

facts.value: 9 mm maximum; FAQ says widths over 5.5 mm need a presser foot attached and the 9 mm needle plate activated
facts.note: Page note: 'the 9 mm maximum stitch width available on some models'.

site.label: Stitch width
site.juki: 9 mm maximum, with the 9 mm needle plate and a suitable foot.

facts.value: 6 mm maximum
'Sewing space to the right of the needle' 8.5 in; 'extended freearm offers 8.5 in right of the needle'
facts.note: Maker wording is right of the needle, which is needle to body. The manual technical data gives no throat figure. The before 2017 page says 7.5 in (maker-pre2017). Bernina's 530, 540, 590 pages show the same 8.5 in.

site.label: Throat
site.juki: 8.5 in right of the needle (maker wording: sewing space to the right of the needle).
site.others: Matches our spec. The earlier 570 QE is 7.5 in.

facts.value: 'Workspace height' listed as 4,3" (comma decimal as printed); no unit conversion given
facts.note: Spec was null. Printed with a comma; treat as 4.3 in and verify against the PDF or a dealer before using.

facts.value: BSR functionality is integrated in the machine; the BERNINA Stitch Regulator (BSR) foot is an optional accessory. Manual supplied-accessory list (p.19 to 21) does not list a BSR foot; BSR connection is on the back panel (p.18)
facts.spec_value: BSR functionality built in; foot optional on some listings, included on others
facts.note: Before 2017 page says 'BSR included' (maker-pre2017), so the older machine shipped with it. Dealer bundles for the current machine vary.

site.label: Stitch regulator
site.juki: BSR functionality integrated; the BSR foot is an optional accessory.
site.others: Some dealer bundles include the foot and some do not; ask before buying.

facts.value: 130/705 (manual technical data)
facts.note: Spec was null.

facts.value: Jumbo bobbin with '70% more capacity'; FAQ: about 100 m of thread, bobbin sensor warns at about 10% left; supplied 'Bobbin for B9 Hook', set of 4
facts.note: The 70 percent and 100 m figures are Bernina wording.

facts.value: LED sewing light; page table shows the number 12 beside it with no unit
facts.note: Spec was null. The meaning of 12 is not explained on the page (assumed LED count, unverified).

facts.value: Knee lifter / Free Hand System (FHS) is a supplied accessory (manual p.19); also automatic presser foot hover function
facts.note: Our spec cited a forum; the maker manual now backs it.

facts.value: Automatic thread cutter, one-button operation
BERNINA Dual Feed, built in, 'tucks away when not in use'
facts.spec_value: Bernina Dual Feed (built in walking foot function)
facts.note: Maker describes Dual Feed; 'walking foot function' is our wording, not Bernina's.

facts.value: 'Powerful DC Motor' (marketing); manual technical data lists energy consumption 90 W, which is not a motor rating
facts.note: Spec was null. Do not present 90 W as motor power.

facts.value: Page: 24.2 lb. Manual technical data: 11.2 kg (25.35 lb)
facts.note: Our 27 lb came from a dealer (smarterfabric.com). Bernina's page and manual disagree with it and with each other by about 1 lb. The earlier 570 QE page says 33 lb.

site.label: Weight
site.others: Our earlier figure was 27 lb from a dealer.

facts.value: Page: 18.1 x 7.9 x 12.9 in labelled W x H x D. Manual: 450 x 330 x 200 mm (17.72 x 12.99 x 7.87 in) W x H x D, without spool pin
facts.note: Spec was null. Page and manual swap height and depth; the manual order (height about 13 in, depth about 7.9 in) is the physically plausible one. Verify against the PDF.

site.label: Size (W x H x D)
site.juki: Manual: 17.7 x 13.0 x 7.9 in. Page prints 18.1 x 7.9 x 12.9 in.
site.others: Page and manual disagree on height and depth.

facts.value: Standard feet #1C, #1D, #2A, #3A (buttonhole with slide), #4D, #20C (open embroidery), #97D (patchwork). Also supplied: slide-on table with seam guide, knee lifter, accessory box, touchscreen pen, 4 B9 bobbins, foam pads
facts.note: Manual p.19 to 21 and the page accessories tab agree. Our realCost note says an extension table is not listed as included; Bernina lists a slide-on table as supplied. BSR foot is not in the list.

site.label: In the box
site.juki: Seven standard feet incl. #97D, slide-on table, knee lifter, 4 bobbins. No BSR foot listed.
site.others: Dealer bundles differ on BSR and extras.

facts.value: 'BERNINA Hook' (page); manual says 'B9 Hook' bobbins
facts.note: Marketing name. The before 2017 machine used the CB hook.

facts.value: Support page: 'BERNINA offers two different models named BERNINA 570 QE'; 2017 and later label reads 'Type: VIO', older reads 'Type: LUN'. Before 2017 page: 7.5 in, 5.5 mm, 900 spm, 642 stitches, 11 buttonholes, 33 lb, 'BSR included', 'no longer available'
facts.note: Confirms our conflicts entry: used listings can carry either generation. Say 'no longer available' only as the older page's wording.

site.label: Which 570 QE
site.juki: Two models share the name. Rear label 'Type: VIO' is 2017 and later; 'Type: LUN' is the earlier one.
site.others: Used listings often omit the year; check the label.

facts.value: Page covers sewing and embroidery: embroidery module optional (Module M SDT optional); embroidery area 15.7 x 5.9 in; 250 built-in designs
facts.note: No '570 QE E' model is named on the Bernina US pages fetched; embroidery is the optional module. Pricing for the module is not on the page.

facts.value: 2 years electrical parts; 5 years printed circuit boards; 20 years mechanical parts, from date of purchase
facts.spec_value: 20 yr mechanical parts, 5 yr printed circuit boards, 2 yr electrical parts
facts.note: Generic US Bernina warranty page, not model-specific; fetched as a search excerpt only. Manual p.159 warns that skipped servicing may limit warranty service.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 2 years electrical, 5 years circuit boards, 20 years mechanical parts.
site.others: Same terms apply across Bernina machines in the US; not specific to this model.

facts.value: 'Made especially for quilters'; 'Handle big quilts with ease'; 'Enjoy superb fabric feed'; 'quality Swiss engineering means great tension and perfect stitches every time'; 'Powerful DC Motor'; Hammer Mode drives the needle 'through more than 30 layers' (marketing)
